nodes.label: Phase 0 stabilization
nodes.description: Document status READY FOR MERGE with staging, CI and production database prerequisites verified; post-release application checks remain required.

nodes.label: HTTP integration fixtures
nodes.description: Real compiled Express and Supabase SDK use ephemeral loopback Auth/PostgREST fixtures; cover token handling, active profiles, memberships, roles and nested project scope.
nodes.rationale: Fixtures avoid production data but cannot prove hosted cryptographic JWT validation or production RLS.

nodes.label: Isolated hosted staging
nodes.description: Separate test Supabase project, branch-scoped Vercel Preview configuration and protected deployment test real authentication and cross-project isolation.

nodes.label: CI and production release gates
nodes.rationale: Require typechecks, builds, integration and privacy tests, frontend regressions, security jobs and live staging checks; release only tested commit and verify production application behavior.

nodes.label: Binary workbook import verification
nodes.description: SheetJS 0.20.3 binary regression tests and hosted synthetic XLSX upload verify activity, progress, risk and financial records; orange-risk parser bug has regression coverage.

nodes.label: Production database prerequisites
nodes.description: On 16 November 2026 migrations 0024, 0025 and 0026 installed atomic invitations, moved privileged helpers out of public schema and restored invitation RLS policies without changing application rows.

nodes.label: Code release rollback
nodes.rationale: Restore known-good Vercel deployment and separately revert offending Git commit; code-only rollback does not restore databases or run migrations.
